alphapartners-baseten:ashbyhq:c29da145-0.title: Executive Assistant to CTO (co-founder) & Head of Engineering
alphapartners-baseten:ashbyhq:c29da145-0.description: ABOUT BASETEN Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to to ship AI products. THE ROLE We’re looking for an experienced Executive Assistant to support our CTO (co-founder) and Head of Engineering. This is a highly operational role that goes well beyond calendar management. You’ll own the day-to-day operating rhythm of the Engineering organization, ensuring leaders are prepared, priorities stay coordinated, and critical meetings, communications, and follow-ups happen seamlessly. You’ll partner closely with senior engineering leaders and serve as a trusted point of coordination for employees, customers, candidates, and external partners. Success in this role comes from exceptional organization, judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to keep many moving pieces aligned in a fast-growing environment. RESPONSIBILITIES - Own complex calendar management for the CTO and Head of Engineering, balancing shifting priorities while ensuring time is allocated intentionally - Ensure leaders are prepared for every day and every meeting by proactively managing agendas, materials, context, logistics, and follow-ups so time is used effectively and decisions move forward - Support forward-looking calendar planning, coordinating recurring operating cadences including roadmap planning, leadership meetings, P0 reviews, Engineering All Hands, and other cross-functional forums - Own the operational cadence of the Engineering organization, including weekly leadership meetings, monthly Show & Tells, Engineering All Hands, roadmap planning, and other recurring forums - Support the CTO (co-founder) and Head of Engineering in delivering an exceptional candidate and new hire experience—from providing high-touch support for executive candidates during onsite interviews to ensuring new team members are welcomed personally during their first week - Partner with customers and external partners to coordinate executive meetings, visits, and other engagements - Manage executive inboxes, helping prioritize communications, triage requests, and ensure timely follow-up - Coordinate domestic and international travel, including last-minute changes - Continuously improve how the Engineering leadership team operates by identifying opportunities to make processes more efficient, scalable, and reliable REQUIREMENTS - 5+ years of experience supporting senior Engineering leaders (CTO, VP Engineering, Head of Engineering, or similar) in a high-growth technology company. You understand how technical organizations operate and have experience supporting engineering operating rhythms, technical planning cycles, and fast-moving product development teams. - Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple competing priorities without dropping details - Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with strong judgment about when and how to communicate on behalf of executives - Demonstrated ability to coordinate complex cross-functional initiatives involving many stakeholders - Experience managing complex calendars, travel, executive communications, and recurring operating cadences - Comfortable working with senior leaders, customers, candidates, and external partners with professionalism and executive presence - Proactive, resourceful, and highly autonomous. bumbleinc-bumbleinc:lever:51d32f4a-e482-.description: Bumble is looking for a Machine Learning Engineer (Computer Vision) to join our Trust & Safety team and play a key role fulfilling our mission to create a world where all relationships are healthy and equitable. Concretely, this means implementing, deploying and maintaining state of the art machine learning models, particularly in computer vision, that help Bumble provide a safe and engaging experience for our users and improve the way Bumble operates. With millions of images and messages exchanged on our platform every day, there is a wealth of opportunity to make a real difference in this role and help people to find love all over the world! The ideal candidate combines strong business acumen, extensive experience in machine learning applications (specifically in Computer Vision) along with a passion for tech.
qualifications: practical experience with recommendation systems, ranking, search or personalisation
expertise in modern machine learning architectures (e.g., transformers, graph neural networks, contrastive learning, and multi-modal embeddings)

cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:fa.title: Heavy Duty Diesel Mechanic (Road Service) - $40–$45/Hour
cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:fa.description: Our client is a family-owned and operated truck and trailer repair shop specializing in dedicated fleet maintenance, with a focus on the car hauling industry. They are fully equipped to handle all aspects of heavy-duty repair, offering top-tier diagnostic tools and a professional, supportive work environment. Our client is seeking a qualified Heavy-Duty (Class A) Diesel Diagnostic Service Technician to perform diagnostic and road service work for commercial vehicles. The technician will handle offsite road service calls as well as onsite repairs, professionally diagnosing and maintaining heavy-duty trucks and trailers. This role includes working with aftertreatment systems, engine diagnostics, air conditioning, electrical systems, and lighting.
responsibilities: Perform offsite and onsite diagnostic and repair work on heavy-duty commercial vehicles.
Diagnose and maintain aftertreatment systems, engine check/stop engine lights, air conditioning, electrical, and lighting systems.
Utilize OEM diagnostic software and tools (Cummins, PACCAR, Snap-on, JPRO, ECT) to efficiently identify and resolve issues.
Maintain accurate records of work performed and communicate with fleet managers or clients as needed.
Adhere to all safety protocols and company procedures.
Maintain punctuality and professionalism at all times.
qualifications: Valid Class A driver’s license (Preferred)
Proven experience as a heavy-duty diesel technician, including diagnostic and road service experience. (At least 5 years of experience)
Ability to professionally and efficiently diagnose and repair a wide range of heavy-duty vehicle issues.
Strong problem-solving and mechanical skills.
Valid Driver License

labhouse-labhouse:ashbyhq:42a27830-173f-.title: Product lead & Data Analyst
labhouse-labhouse:ashbyhq:42a27830-173f-.description: Labhouse is a fast-growing startup that builds, launches, and scales its own AI & Productivity Apps, operating under a subscription-based business model. Based in Barcelona, Labhouse was founded by Andrés Bou and Horacio Martos (Co-Founders of SocialPoint). We operate at the intersection of mobile technology, AI, and product-driven growth, with a strong focus on experimentation and performance. Would you like to make an impact as part of a company that builds the best mobile apps used by millions of users worldwide? If so, discover your next challenge below. Now we're looking for a Product lead & Data Analyst to work side by side with our CEO, turning data into the apps of tomorrow 🚀 ABOUT THE ROLE As Data Product Manager, you'll partner directly with the CEO to launch new apps and evolve our existing portfolio. You'll bring a data-first mindset to product decisions — using user behavior, experimentation, and analytics to identify opportunities, prioritize features, and ship products that scale. This role requires someone highly autonomous, entrepreneurial, and impact-driven, capable of defining KPIs, building dashboards, and making data-informed decisions. You'll be responsible for: - Working hand in hand with the CEO to ideate, validate, and launch new mobile apps - Driving product decisions on existing apps using data, experimentation, and user insights - Defining and tracking the metrics that matter: activation, retention, monetization, LTV - Designing and analyzing A/B tests, onboarding flows, and monetization experiments - Translating raw data into clear product hypotheses and roadmap priorities - Collaborating with engineering, design, and marketing to ship fast and iterate faster - Leveraging AI tools to accelerate research, prototyping, and decision-making ABOUT YOU: Academic background: - Degree in a quantitative or technical field — Data Science, Data Engineering, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, or similar - Strong academic record from a top-tier university What are we looking for: - 2-4 years of experience as a Data Scientist, Data Engineer, or Data Analyst, who has transitioned into product - Solid analytical foundation: SQL, statistics, experimentation, and product metrics (CAC, LTV, retention, ARPU) - A genuine product mindset — you don't just analyze data, you ask why and propose what to build next - High agency, ownership, and bias for action - Comfortable working directly with founders in a fast-paced environment - Strong proficiency with AI tools to accelerate your workflow - Passion for UI/UX and Apple-like product experiences Communication: - Strong level of spoken and written English and Spanish - Clear, structured communicator who can simplify complex data into product narratives NICE TO HAVE: - Experience building products from 0 to 1. - Experience working closely with founders or in startup environments. - Ability to work remote or hybrid (Barcelona-based preferred). WHAT WE OFFER: - The opportunity to work side by side with serial entrepreneurs who've built and exited at the highest level - A real path to becoming a product leader, mentored directly by the CEO - Attractive compensation package, above market average - Hybrid work model from our Barcelona office - A fast-moving, AI-native environment where shipping beats talking HIRING PROCESS 1. TA Interview – Initial conversation to get to know each other and understand your background. 2. Technical Case – Practical exercise to assess your product, analytical, and strategic capabilities. 3. CEO / Product Team Interview – Deep dive into your product thinking, experience, and fit with the team. 4. Final Interview – Final conversation to ensure alignment on expectations, culture, and role fit. YOU SHOULD KNOW: Labhouse is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. phiraventures-phira-ventures:ashbyhq:502.title: Content Marketing Manager (German)
phiraventures-phira-ventures:ashbyhq:502.description: Remote-first (Lisbon-based team) | Native German | 25 hours/week or full-time At Phira Venture Studio, we build and invest in businesses with purpose. This role is at one of our portfolio brands whose team you'd be joining directly. The brand sells health & wellness products DTC in the German market. The hero product has won many awards and is well-established in its segment. Over 200,000 people already love our brand, and we want a lot more to discover it. That's why we're looking for a German-speaking content marketer who can shape the brand's voice, keep messaging consistent across every channel, and write copy that catches people’s attention. You will be in charge of every email, every ad, and every line on the website. Your work will directly drive the success of the business, and you will have an impact from day one. WHAT YOU'LL DO We're a small team, so there are no long approval lines. We will give you the freedom to make decisions yourself that other organizations would take weeks to settle on. We will value your ideas and give you the means to implement them. This will not only help you to advance your career but also accelerate your learning, because you see the consequences of your own calls. Your three core areas: - Email marketing: campaigns, flows, and growing our newsletter list. - Ad copy: angles, hooks, and headlines for paid campaigns, written to be tested, iterated, and improved. - Website copy: product pages, landing pages, and everything that turns a visitor into a customer. Across all three, you'll: - Shape the brand voice: how it sounds, what it stands for, and how those values reach the customer. - Help grow the brand and sharpen its positioning: messaging, angles, and campaign ideas. Content isn't downstream of the strategy; it's part of it - Analyze what your content does to the business, not just to the campaign. You'll have the real numbers - revenue, conversion rate, AOV, repeat purchases - and you’ll use them to decide what you write next. - Work in close collaboration with the team: marketing, design, product, and development - Use AI tools to scale your output without diluting quality. We are an AI-first organization and are embracing its advantage, but have no tolerance for AI slop. - Apply SEO & GEO best practices so the content you write has a lasting impact If you join full-time: social media content becomes part of the job as well. You'd take over the full process, from idea to shooting to editing, and grow our socials into another meaningful channel. Real affinity for social helps here: you spend time on the platforms, you know the formats, and you have a feel for why one video works and the next one doesn't. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Native or near-native German, with flawless grammar and an instinct for tone. You write copy that sounds personal. You use AI to leverage your time, but don’t let it take over your thinking. - 1+ years of content marketing experience (e-commerce or DTC preferred) - You notice ads instead of scrolling past them, you're subscribed to newsletters you don't strictly need, and you can say what makes a good one work. You know what's working right now and what's already worn out. - Analytical instincts: you're comfortable in the numbers. You can read campaign performance, spot what's working, form a hypothesis, and rewrite accordingly. - Demonstrated AI proficiency: concrete examples of AI-driven gains in speed and quality - Ownership mindset: you set your own deadlines and hit them without being chased - Extremely organized: clean workflows, on top of the details, clear bias to action - A strong, proactive communicator - Proof you execute: writing samples, campaigns, projects, brand work NICE TO HAVE - Familiarity with email CRMs such as Klaviyo or similar - Previous experience with SEO / GEO - Basic content production skills (shooting, editing) - Based in Lisbon WHAT YOU'LL GET - Real ownership from day one - A proven product and an established brand, where your w

qualdoc-qualdoc:lever:c705a279-0b6a-4fd0.title: Buyer / Material Planning Specialist
qualdoc-qualdoc:lever:c705a279-0b6a-4fd0.description: Buyer / Material Planner – Electrical Manufacturing Location: Marietta, OH Job Type: Full-Time, Direct Hire Starting Salary: Compensation starts based on experience Travel: Up to 10% for supplier visits and trade shows Position Overview Seeking a Buyer Planner to manage purchasing and material planning for electromechanical power distribution products. This role works closely with engineering, production, quality, logistics, and sales to ensure components are purchased on time, inventory remains balanced, and production has the materials needed to meet customer commitments. Products supported include Power Distribution Cabinets (PDCs), Static Transfer Switches (STS), Remote Power Panels (RPPs), and Medium/Low Voltage Switchgear assemblies.
responsibilities: Purchase and manage electrical and electromechanical components, including wires, cables, energy meters, bus bars, circuit breakers, contactors, transformers, enclosures, cable assemblies, and switchgear components.
Create and manage purchase orders, including spot buys and blanket POs.
Source suppliers and negotiate pricing, payment terms, lead times, and agreements.
Monitor supplier performance, including on-time delivery, quality, and lead-time compliance.
Identify and address single-source, long-lead, and other supply risks.
Use ERP/MRP systems to review demand, plan material requirements, and support production schedules.
Maintain item master information, including lead times, safety stock, MOQs, and reorder points.
Monitor inventory and resolve shortages while balancing material availability and working capital.
Expedite critical materials to protect production schedules and customer delivery commitments.
Coordinate with production scheduling to align material availability with manufacturing needs.
Perform cycle counts and investigate inventory discrepancies.
Work with engineering on new product introductions, ECOs, and BOM accuracy.
Partner with quality on SCARs, NCMs, and first-article inspections.
Coordinate with receiving and logistics teams on inbound shipments and material discrepancies.
Provide material availability and supply risk updates to sales and program management.
Participate in SIOP and production readiness reviews.
Track supply chain metrics including PPV, supplier on-time delivery, inventory turns, and material shortages.
Support cost reduction, supplier consolidation, value engineering, and total cost of ownership initiatives.
Promote accurate ERP usage, lean practices, and continuous improvement.
qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Operations, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
3–5+ years of buyer and/or material planning experience in manufacturing.
5 years of minimum overall experience preferred.
Experience purchasing electrical, electronic, or electromechanical components.
Experience buying materials for manufactured or assembled products.
Proficiency with ERP/MRP systems, such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Epicor, Infor, or similar.
Strong understanding of MRP, demand planning, and material flow from purchase order through receiving, put-away, picking, assembly, and shipping.
Experience with material planning and purchasing within a production environment.
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, BOMs, and technical specifications.
Strong negotiation, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, VLOOKUP, and supply/demand analysis.
Experience in power distribution, electrical switchgear, UPS, or critical power industries.
Familiarity with PDCs, STS units, RPPs, panelboards, or MV/LV switchgear.
APICS CPIM or CSCP or ISM C.P.M./CPSM certification.
Experience with Lean/Six Sigma and continuous improvement.
Knowledge of UL, ANSI, IEC, NEMA, and NEC standards.
Supplier development and international sourcing experience.
Familiarity with customs and import compliance for electrical components.

qualdoc-qualdoc:lever:eccd04c9-3a8a-475b.title: Structural Steel Quality Inspector
qualdoc-qualdoc:lever:eccd04c9-3a8a-475b.description: Structural Steel Quality Control Inspector Location: Richmond, VA Job Type: Contract-to-Hire Shift: 1st Shift Starting Pay: $31.00/hour — higher depending on experience Schedule: Monday–Friday; Saturday overtime available Position Overview We are looking for an experienced Structural Steel Quality Control Inspector to inspect fabricated steel components and help maintain quality throughout the production process. Experienced senior-level structural steel fitters or fabricators may also be considered.
responsibilities: Inspect fabricated structural steel throughout the production process
Perform in-process and final quality inspections
Verify dimensions, layout, and component placement
Compare materials and completed work against shop drawings and specifications
Identify, document, and follow up on nonconforming work in accordance with AWS D1.1/D1.5
Work with fabrication and production teams to correct quality issues
Support quality improvement efforts and process improvements
Participate in annual AISC quality-control audits
qualifications: 3–5 years of structural steel layout and fabrication experience
Ability to read and interpret fabrication and construction drawings
Strong knowledge of structural steel fabrication and quality requirements
Welding certification in AWS D1.1 and/or D1.5 preferred
Strong attention to detail and ability to identify dimensional and fabrication issues
